records.context: The BBBC021 benchmark (Ljosa et al. 2013) as the reanalysis's scorer of record runs it (``run_and_score.py`` and ``supervised_moa.py``):
records.label: spacr.sp_stats.moa_evaluation#1
records.source: The BBBC021 benchmark (Ljosa et al. 2013) as the reanalysis's scorer of record runs it (``run_and_score.py`` and ``supervised_moa.py``):
records.translation: El banco de pruebas BBBC021 (Ljosa et al. 2013) tal como lo ejecuta el evaluador de referencia del reanálisis (``run_and_score.py`` y ``supervised_moa.py``):

records.context: 1. every microplate sample position gets its laboratory microplate, microplate sample position, compound and concentration (from ``metadata`` when the profiles lack them) and every numeric column outside the structured-data names, counts and ``moa_eval_exclude`` is a feature; 2. each laboratory microplate is normalised to its control microplate sample positions (``moa_eval_normalise``) and a feature without a finite positive scale on some laboratory microplate is dropped; ``moa_eval_feature_qc='standard'`` then drops a feature non-finite in more than 5% of microplate sample positions or above 500 after normalisation (pycytominer's drop_na_columns and drop_outliers, item 807); 3. the labelled microplate sample positions (``moa_eval_labels``, controls left out) are scored by each method of ``moa_eval_methods``, leaving one compound out (:mod:`spacr.moa_benchmark`): ``1nn_cosine`` on treatment profiles (replicate microplate sample positions combined by ``moa_eval_replicates``), and the supervised ``logistic``, ``xgboost``, ``lda``, ``shrinkage_lda``, ``knn`` and the nine CellProfiler Analyst 3.0.5 machine-learning classification models ``cpa_<name>`` (:mod:`spacr.cpa_classifiers`) on the microplate sample positions, as ``float32``; 4. per seed the supervised fits use that seed, and the shuffled-label control permutes the compound-to-MoA mapping with generator seed ``seed + 1`` and refits with seeds ``seed + 1 + i`` (the reference's convention at seed 0); the 1-NN control uses generator seed ``seed``. The majority-class control counts the treatments the first method scored.
records.label: spacr.sp_stats.moa_evaluation#2
records.source: 1. every well gets its plate, well, compound and concentration (from ``metadata`` when the profiles lack them) and every numeric column outside the keys, counts and ``moa_eval_exclude`` is a feature; 2. each plate is normalised to its control wells (``moa_eval_normalise``) and a feature without a finite positive scale on some plate is dropped; ``moa_eval_feature_qc='standard'`` then drops a feature non-finite in more than 5% of wells or above 500 after normalisation (pycytominer's drop_na_columns and drop_outliers, item 807); 3. the labelled wells (``moa_eval_labels``, controls left out) are scored by each method of ``moa_eval_methods``, leaving one compound out (:mod:`spacr.moa_benchmark`): ``1nn_cosine`` on treatment profiles (replicate wells combined by ``moa_eval_replicates``), and the supervised ``logistic``, ``xgboost``, ``lda``, ``shrinkage_lda``, ``knn`` and the nine CellProfiler Analyst 3.0.5 classifiers ``cpa_<name>`` (:mod:`spacr.cpa_classifiers`) on the wells, as ``float32``; 4. per seed the supervised fits use that seed, and the shuffled-label control permutes the compound-to-MoA mapping with generator seed ``seed + 1`` and refits with seeds ``seed + 1 + i`` (the reference's convention at seed 0); the 1-NN control uses generator seed ``seed``. The majority-class control counts the treatments the first method scored.
records.translation: 1. cada pocillo recibe su placa, pocillo, compuesto y concentración (de ``metadata`` cuando faltan en los perfiles) y cada columna numérica fuera de las claves, los recuentos y ``moa_eval_exclude`` es una característica; 2. cada placa se normaliza a sus pocillos control (``moa_eval_normalise``) y se descarta una característica sin escala positiva finita en alguna placa; ``moa_eval_feature_qc='standard'`` descarta después una característica no finita en más del 5% de los pocillos o superior a 500 tras la normalización (drop_na_columns y drop_outliers de pycytominer, ítem 807); 3. los pocillos etiquetados (``moa_eval_labels``, sin los controles) se puntúan con cada método de ``moa_eval_methods``, dejando fuera un compuesto cada vez (:mod:`spacr.moa_benchmark`): ``1nn_cosine`` sobre perfiles de tratamiento (pocillos réplica combinados mediante ``moa_eval_replicates``), y los supervisados ``logistic``, ``xgboost``, ``lda``, ``shrinkage_lda``, ``knn`` y los nueve clasificadores ``cpa_<name>`` de CellProfiler Analyst 3.0.5 (:mod:`spacr.cpa_classifiers`) sobre los pocillos, como ``float32``; 4. en cada semilla los ajustes supervisados usan esa semilla, y el control de etiquetas barajadas permuta el mapeo de compuesto a MoA con semilla de generador ``seed + 1`` y reajusta con las semillas ``seed + 1 + i`` (la convención de la referencia con semilla 0); el control 1-NN usa la semilla de generador ``seed``. El control de clase mayoritaria cuenta los tratamientos que puntuó el primer método.

records.label: spacr.well_set_training#0
records.source: Train and score the spaCR well transformer on per-cell embeddings, with its ablations and controls.
records.translation: Entrena y puntúa el transformador de pocillos de spaCR sobre incrustaciones por célula, con sus ablaciones y controles.

records.context: A microplate sample position is a set of single-cell embeddings (such as the per-channel ResNet-18 embeddings :mod:`spacr.embedding_profiles` writes, ``<plate>.npy`` beside the extracted image region index ``<plate>.cells.parquet``). This module trains the :class:`spacr.channel_models.SpacrWellTransformer` on those sets, the way the BMC reanalysis ``train_well.py`` did, and scores it on BBBC021-style mechanism-of-action (MoA) folds:
records.label: spacr.well_set_training#1
records.source: A well is a set of single-cell embeddings (such as the per-channel ResNet-18 embeddings :mod:`spacr.embedding_profiles` writes, ``<plate>.npy`` beside the crop index ``<plate>.cells.parquet``). This module trains the :class:`spacr.channel_models.SpacrWellTransformer` on those sets, the way the BMC reanalysis ``train_well.py`` did, and scores it on BBBC021-style mechanism-of-action (MoA) folds:
records.translation: Un pocillo es un conjunto de incrustaciones de células individuales (como las incrustaciones ResNet-18 por canal que escribe :mod:`spacr.embedding_profiles`, ``<plate>.npy`` junto al índice de recortes ``<plate>.cells.parquet``). Este módulo entrena el :class:`spacr.channel_models.SpacrWellTransformer` sobre esos conjuntos, como lo hacía ``train_well.py`` del reanálisis BMC, y lo puntúa en folds de mecanismo de acción (MoA) al estilo de BBBC021:

records.context: 1. :func:`load_cell_embeddings` reads the embeddings and normalises them without labels (``train_set_normalisation``): ``'plate_control_pca'`` centres and scales every dimension per laboratory microplate by that laboratory microplate's control (DMSO) cells, then whitens with a PCA fitted on control cells of all laboratory microplates (typical-variation-normalisation-like, Ando et al. 2017); the control is the negative control on every laboratory microplate, so using it on test laboratory microplates is not label leakage. ``'plate_control'`` stops after the laboratory microplate step and ``'none'`` keeps the embeddings as they are. 2. :func:`group_wells` groups the cells into microplate sample positions, and :func:`moa_folds` gives the folds of ``train_protocol``: ``'NSCB'`` (not same compound or batch: one fold per batch, plus the taxol 1 and 3 uM fold) or ``'NSC'`` (not same compound: four folds, every compound of a MoA in another fold). 3. :func:`train_arrayed` trains one arm per fold, and :func:`predict_arrayed` predicts the test microplate sample positions. Arms (:data:`WELL_SET_ARMS`): ``settf`` (ISAB set encoder and gated attention-MIL), ``abmil`` (attention-MIL only), ``n1`` (set size 1 in training and test, the well being the mean of its cells' softmax: the no-context ablation), ``mixbag`` (bags drawn from cells of random training microplate sample positions of the same class, which keeps the label but breaks within-well co-occurrence), ``mean_lr`` (mean profile and logistic regression) and ``mean_knn`` (mean profile and cosine 1-NN on treatment profiles, the classic BBBC021 baseline). 4. :func:`score_treatments` scores the microplate sample positions as the reference ``eval_bbbc.py`` does: well softmax with untrained classes zeroed, treatment mean, argmax; accuracy with a bootstrap confidence interval over treatments, macro AUROC and macro AP.
records.label: spacr.well_set_training#2
records.source: 1. :func:`load_cell_embeddings` reads the embeddings and normalises them without labels (``train_set_normalisation``): ``'plate_control_pca'`` centres and scales every dimension per plate by that plate's control (DMSO) cells, then whitens with a PCA fitted on control cells of all plates (typical-variation-normalisation-like, Ando et al. 2017); the control is the negative control on every plate, so using it on test plates is not label leakage. ``'plate_control'`` stops after the plate step and ``'none'`` keeps the embeddings as they are. 2. :func:`group_wells` groups the cells into wells, and :func:`moa_folds` gives the folds of ``train_protocol``: ``'NSCB'`` (not same compound or batch: one fold per batch, plus the taxol 1 and 3 uM fold) or ``'NSC'`` (not same compound: four folds, every compound of a MoA in another fold). 3. :func:`train_arrayed` trains one arm per fold, and :func:`predict_arrayed` predicts the test wells. Arms (:data:`WELL_SET_ARMS`): ``settf`` (ISAB set encoder and gated attention-MIL), ``abmil`` (attention-MIL only), ``n1`` (set size 1 in training and test, the well being the mean of its cells' softmax: the no-context ablation), ``mixbag`` (bags drawn from cells of random training wells of the same class, which keeps the label but breaks within-well co-occurrence), ``mean_lr`` (mean profile and logistic regression) and ``mean_knn`` (mean profile and cosine 1-NN on treatment profiles, the classic BBBC021 baseline). 4. :func:`score_treatments` scores the wells as the reference ``eval_bbbc.py`` does: well softmax with untrained classes zeroed, treatment mean, argmax; accuracy with a bootstrap confidence interval over treatments, macro AUROC and macro AP.
records.translation: 1. :func:`load_cell_embeddings` lee las incrustaciones y las normaliza sin etiquetas (``train_set_normalisation``): ``'plate_control_pca'`` centra y escala cada dimensión por placa según las células control (DMSO) de esa placa, y luego blanquea con un PCA ajustado sobre células control de todas las placas (similar a la normalización de variación típica, Ando et al. 2017); el control es el control negativo en cada placa, así que usarlo en las placas de prueba no es fuga de etiquetas. ``'plate_control'`` se detiene tras el paso por placa y ``'none'`` deja las incrustaciones tal cual. 2. :func:`group_wells` agrupa las células en pocillos y :func:`moa_folds` da los folds de ``train_protocol``: ``'NSCB'`` (ni el mismo compuesto ni el mismo lote: un fold por lote, más el fold de taxol a 1 y 3 uM) o ``'NSC'`` (no el mismo compuesto: cuatro folds, cada compuesto de un MoA en otro fold). 3. :func:`train_arrayed` entrena un brazo por fold y :func:`predict_arrayed` predice los pocillos de prueba. Brazos (:data:`WELL_SET_ARMS`): ``settf`` (codificador de conjuntos ISAB y attention-MIL con compuerta), ``abmil`` (solo attention-MIL), ``n1`` (tamaño de conjunto 1 en entrenamiento y prueba, siendo el pocillo la media del softmax de sus células: la ablación sin contexto), ``mixbag`` (bolsas extraídas de células de pocillos de entrenamiento aleatorios de la misma clase, lo que conserva la etiqueta pero rompe la coocurrencia dentro del pocillo), ``mean_lr`` (perfil medio y regresión logística) y ``mean_knn`` (perfil medio y 1-NN por coseno sobre perfiles de tratamiento, la línea base clásica de BBBC021). 4. :func:`score_treatments` puntúa los pocillos como la referencia ``eval_bbbc.py``: softmax por pocillo con las clases no entrenadas a cero, media por tratamiento, argmax; exactitud con un intervalo de confianza bootstrap sobre los tratamientos, AUROC macro y AP macro.

Synthetic data with known penetrance (:func:`synthetic_arrayed`) and with a microplate sample position batch effect (:func:`synthetic_pooled`) check the arrayed and the pooled mode on the CPU.

Synthetic data with known penetrance (:func:`synthetic_arrayed`) and with a well batch effect (:func:`synthetic_pooled`) check the arrayed and the pooled mode on the CPU.
records.translation: :func:`run_well_set_arm` ejecuta un brazo a partir de un dict de configuración; :func:`run_well_set_training` ejecuta cada brazo de ``train_set_arms`` a partir de los ajustes de :mod:`spacr.architecture_training`, con el control de etiquetas barajadas (``train_set_shuffle_control``: se permuta el mapeo de compuesto a MoA) y el control de clase mayoritaria, y escribe ``summary.csv`` con una fila por brazo y control. Datos sintéticos con penetrancia conocida (:func:`synthetic_arrayed`) y con un efecto de lote por pocillo (:func:`synthetic_pooled`) comprueban los modos arrayed y pooled en la CPU.
